title: SCP-789-J, The Butt Ghost
description: A face of a ghost in a toilet that will eat you while you're siting on a toilet...
body:
The Butt Ghosts adds a new entity. Its history comes from the SCP universe, where it is referred to as SCP-789-J, also known as the Butt Ghost.


Players can now craft toilets that are useful. Sitting on a toilet clears dirt from the player’s inventory and converts it into XP, sometimes with a fart sound. Toilets close automatically when the player stands up, but can also be shut manually by sneaking. However, opening a toilet has a 40% chance that SCP-789-J appears in the toilet. Sitting on SCP-789-J grants more XP, but also inflicts heavy damage while the entity talks to the player. Once SCP-789-J is inside a toilet, it cannot be removed by breaking it. The only way to purge the curse is by using a plunger on the toilet.

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► Where does SCP-789-J spawn?

SCP-789-J doesnt spawn by itself. You need to craft a toilet and when you open it, there is a chance of it to appear in your toilet.

</details>



![SCP-789-J](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fa373fa7d825a0531800afc3795dbc7de9226839.png)

SCP-789-J appears inside toilets with a 40% chance when opened. If a player sits on it, dirt while be converted into more XP than siting on a normal toilet, but the player suffers high damage and hears SCP-789-J speaking. Once inside, the toilet cannot be closed or reclaimed, and breaking it only drops SCP-789-J in its toilet form, ensuring the curse follows the player. The only counter is using a plunger to finally remove SCP-789-J from your toilet.
